# Fractional BD

> Fractional sales and business development leadership for technology companies entering or scaling in Canada, from Adnan Kichlu, a senior business development executive based in Toronto, Ontario.

Fractional BD places a senior executive on a monthly engagement in place of a full-time sales hire. Typical clients are early-stage technology companies and international companies new to the Canadian market, selling SaaS, AI, security, building technology, proptech and similar products to commercial buyers.
